regions.merged_text: Rose Marg. H. (ickey) 21 of Lima Ohio, after one year in the Novit- iate with SSrs of Charity Mt. St Jos becomes "lonesome" and discon- tented, etc - her Mother continually pleading for her return. She left, came to Detroit, fell unfortunatly and is now in a home pro- viding for wayward girls; she thinks she can marry the man when his wife dies.

regions.merged_text: Demended since 6 month old. Paul Martin (now 21) in LePiere, Mich. Institution 12 years has been without the use of reason - seemingly blighted when 6 months old, then a most promising baby. He does not know anyone even his mother, whose heart aches with maternal sympathy whenever she visits him - enrolled To-day for two years.

regions.merged_text: Anna Schram, 30, of 99 Yellow-Stone Ave (City) operated on for gall- stones Dec. 18th - then Jan. 20 another operation - double for ab- sesses on liver declared as absolutely hopeless, then in dying con- dition. Her sister has Enrolled her Jan. 23 and To-day anounces her as already back home P.S. One only case besides of similar gravity in Grace Hospital died after operation 5 yrs ago.
